texts.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个星门之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
texts.en:
An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "Gateway" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of similar stations that at some point would have allowed for near-instantaneous travel between different parts of the galaxy.

Assuming this is a Gateway, its current state of disrepair has rendered it unusable. If it could be restored into working order, its owner would potentially be able to access any other functional gateways in the galaxy, enabling travel across huge distances in a matter of days.

texts.zh: 我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在[gateway_system.GetName]星系中。和之前的传送门不同，这个传送门并没有被人为改动过且与网络中的其他传送门连接正常。但由于破损严重，此传送门暂时无法使用。
texts.en: We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time in the [gateway_system.GetName] system. Unlike the previous one, this Gateway has not been altered in any obvious way and our scans indicate that it is still connected to the rest of the network. However, it is currently inoperable due to its poor condition.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已成功恢复了了位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系星门的能源！虽然这装置年代久远，但还是形成了一个完全可通过的亚空间通路。

我们送去的探测器确认，我们激活此星门的行为也为第二座设施提供了能源。现在，这两个连接的星门是我们当前仅有的两个可以使用的设施，但是很可能在别的地方找到其他的处于休眠状态的设施。将来我们甚至能够在选定的星系重新建造全新的星门。
texts.en:
Our scientists have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

The probes we sent through have confirmed that our activation of this Gateway has restored power to a second, identical device. For now, these two linked Gateways are the only ones that are accessible to us, but more inert devices can likely be found elsewhere. In the future, we may even be able to construct entirely new Gateways in systems of our choosing!

texts.zh:
我们的科学家已成功恢复了了位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系星门的能源！虽然这装置年代久远，但还是形成了一个完全可通过的亚空间通路。

我们发射的探测器确认此星门与整个网络的连接十分稳定。我们的舰船可以通过它旅行到其他激活的星门，只要星门的拥有者对我们不敌对或是对我们关闭了边境就没问题。
texts.en:
Our scientists have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

The probes we have sent through confirm that this Gateway has achieved a strong link to the rest of the network. Our ships can now travel through it to other active Gateways, as long as their owners aren't hostile or have closed their borders to us.

texts.zh: 位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系的被遗弃的传送门突然被激活了！很可能是其他地方的星门将此传送门的能源恢复了，现在此星门已经形成了一个稳定的亚空间回路，应该可以进行传送了。
texts.en: The abandoned Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system has suddenly been reactivated! Power must have been remotely restored to it somehow, possibly from another Gateway. It has formed a stable subspace conduit that appears traversable.

texts.zh:
位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系的被遗弃的传送门突然被激活了！很可能是其他地方的星门将此传送门的能源恢复了，现在此星门已经形成了一个稳定的亚空间回路，应该可以进行传送了。

但是，我们无法进入星门，星门周围的亚空间力场会推开任何接近的舰船。在我们可以使用这个星门之前，我们必须研究从我们这侧激活星门的方法，这样它才能允许我们的舰船通行。
texts.en:
The abandoned Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system has suddenly been reactivated! Power must have been remotely restored to it somehow, possibly from another Gateway. It has formed a stable subspace conduit that appears traversable.

Unfortunately, the Gateway does not allow us access. The subspace field surrounding the device pushes our ships away whenever they approach. Before we can make use of it, we will have to research some way of activating the Gateway from our side so that it allows our ships to pass.

label.en: Something might come through at any time!

texts.en: Power has been restored to the derelict Gateway that was found in the [gateway_system.GetName] system. It has been connected to the rest of the Gateway network and is now fully operational.

summary.text:
# 遗弃星门 / Abandoned Gateway

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- DLC：Apocalypse

## 如何开始 How it starts

飞船首次进入带有 abandoned_gateway 标记、含已废弃星门（gateway_ruined）的星系，且本国尚未遇到过任何星门（flag encountered_first_gateway）时，触发 apoc.1（on_entering_system_first_time）。

A ship first entering a system flagged abandoned_gateway that holds a ruined gateway (gateway_ruined), when the empire has not met a gateway before (flag encountered_first_gateway), triggers apoc.1 (on_entering_system_first_time).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

apoc.1 发现废弃星门（唯一选项“有意思”，正文因是否已遇到L星门而异）。研究“星门激活”科技后可把星门升级为修复状态，耗时720天、花费6000能量和2500合金；完成时通知玩家：首座被激活的星门显示 apoc.10，之后的显示 apoc.12。apoc.10 的选项依是否放弃修复（did_not_repair_gateway）和是否有科技而异。

apoc.1 reports the derelict gateway (single option; the text differs if an L-gate was met). With the Gateway Activation technology the gateway can be upgraded to restored (720 days, 6000 energy + 2500 alloys); on completion the player gets apoc.10 for the first gateway activated and apoc.12 for later ones. The options of apoc.10 depend on did_not_repair_gateway and the technology.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

apoc.10 与 apoc.12 互斥；没有其他分支。

apoc.10 and apoc.12 are exclusive; there are no other branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

apoc.10 的正文有四种（激活星门数量、是否未亲自修复/是否有激活科技）；未亲自修复且没有激活科技时，选项 apoc.10.a 会添加研究选项“星门激活”。

apoc.10 has four text variants (number of active gateways; did not repair / has the activation technology); when the gateway was not repaired by the empire and it lacks the activation technology, option apoc.10.a adds the research option Gateway Activation.
